title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki BetaFeatures Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, and 1.46. The issue is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the includes/HTMLFeatureField.php file. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.6.
